_metadata.title: International Role-Level Recruitment Benchmarks v1
_metadata.description: Vertical × country × role-level CPA, CPH, apply rate, hiring difficulty, and platform pricing. Built to supplement international_benchmarks_2026.json with role granularity Nova chatbot needs to answer queries like 'CPA for nurses in London' or 'how much to hire a software engineer in Berlin'.
_metadata.currency_note: USD equivalents use mid-May 2026 mid-market exchange rates. Local currency figures are primary.
_metadata.methodology: 1) Live Adzuna API pulls for 11 markets × 6 categories (66 cells). 2) Tavily web search across 28+ recruitment benchmark reports. 3) Government statistics (BLS, ONS, INSEE, HSE Ireland, NHS, Bundesagentur). 4) Cross-referenced every CPA/CPH cell against at least 2 sources where possible; single-source cells flagged. 5) Unverified data placed in `data_gaps`, not estimated.

confidence_levels.medium: 2+ sources with some variance OR 1 government/tier-1 source
confidence_levels.low: Tier-2/3 source only, less recent, or extrapolated
confidence_levels.single_source: Only one source available; treat with caution
confidence_levels.estimated: Triangulated from country aggregates × vertical premium/discount factors; NOT primary

_metadata.primary_use_case: Power Nova chatbot answers for queries like 'CPA for nurses in London', 'how much to hire a chef in Sydney', 'IT engineer cost in Berlin'.

Lower-confidence: inferred sector splits and bilingual premium (LOW).
